senses.gloss: in natural condition, whence (cmp. אֵיתָן) healthy, strong, stout, fat.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:3:4">Y. Naz. VI, 55ᵇ</cite> top (opp. <cite ref="V01068"><he>תש</he></cite>, of tender build); a. fr.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:16">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:4:11">Y. Pes. II, 29ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דבר ב׳ שלא וכ׳</he> it is sure that he did not &c.—<he>ב׳ לי</he> I am sure.

<cite ref="Chullin 10a:8">Ḥull. 10ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>ב׳ ושמא</he> ‘sure’ and ‘perhaps’, the plea of two litigants, one asserting a certainty, the other pleading ignorance or offering a possible alternative.
<cite ref="Ketubot 12b:6">Keth. 12ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 37b:5">B. Mets. 37ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> honey <he>ב׳ כאבן</he> as solid as a stone; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בְּרִיאִים</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:1">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> <he>ב׳ כאולם</he> as sound as the Temple hall.—
<cite ref="Chullin 84a:22">Ḥull. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>ממשפחת ב׳</he> of a healthy, stout family; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="B01242"><he>בְּרִיאָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:12">Kidd. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>בבל ב׳</he> Babylon is sound (as to purity of descent).
<cite ref="Eruvin 62a:7">Erub. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>שכירות ב׳</he> a sound (legitimate) lease, opp. <he>רעועה</he> rickety; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:3:6">Y. Erub. I, 19ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="B01261"><he>בְּרִיָּיה</he></cite> a strong, solid rafter.—Pl. <cite ref="B01243"><he>בְּרִיאוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="B01251"><he>בְּרִיּיוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:3:6">Ib.</cite> top <he>ברויות</he> ed. Krot. (corr. acc.).
